title: 第13章 系统你给我个痛快算了第14章 最后一天
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
龙涛看着任务面板上的内容，一时半会儿都没有回过神来，他用力眨了眨眼，又反复确认了三遍，那行冰冷的文字依旧清晰刺目，系统让他去明烛真人的浴室外签到，并且还要带着南宇辰去偷窥他师尊洗澡。
一股冰冷的麻木感瞬间淹没了所有情绪。
他甚至失去了咒骂的力气，只是呆呆地僵坐着，脑海里只剩下一个荒诞而冰冷的念头在盘旋......
横竖都是个死，是被明烛真人一指头碾成飞灰痛快些？还是被这狗系统无声无息抹杀掉干净点？尽量挑个不那么痛苦的死法算了。
“龙师兄？怎么了吗？突然不说话了。”
南宇辰看着突然陷入沉默，甚至眼神都有些呆呆的龙涛，终于还是忍不住叫了叫。
“啊...没什么，”
龙涛几乎是榨干了全身的力气，才勉强扯出一个比哭还难看的笑容，“就是...听你说起这些，忽然想起我刚入门时，被那些老杂役欺负的往事，唉...都不容易，都不容易啊...”
龙涛几乎是使出全部的演技，才勉强让自己看起来正常些，不然他真的会控制不住自己，在这个酒楼内崩溃爆发出来，这狗日的系统，之前那个任务好歹还算是九死一生，这次...让他怎么搞！
那可是金丹真人！
一峰之主！
漱月峰就是她的绝对领域！
他一个练气小虾米，怕是刚踏入峰界范围，就会被那无处不在的恐怖神识锁定，碾死他比碾死一只蚂蚁还轻松！
跟明烛真人比起来，之前那头威风凛凛的筑基狼王，就是只大一些的宠物狗！
而南宇辰则没注意到龙涛内心的惊涛骇浪，只是跟着抱怨起自己的委屈。
看着眼前的傻小子，龙涛原本绝望的内心又燃起了一丝丝的小火苗，对了...这小子是明烛真人最宠爱的小弟子，那...从他身上说不定能找到那几乎不可能存在的突破点，比如...进入任务地点的门票。
和上次遇到的困境一样，自己一个练气五层的外门弟子，正常来说根本不可能进得了漱月峰，和无风崖那种宗门公共地带不同，漱月峰是明烛真人的私人领地，没办法通过正常手段进去。
妈的！
他算是彻底明白了！
这狗系统发布的任务，就是为南宇辰量身定做的爽文剧本！

让他去偷窥美女师父洗澡，估计也就被揪着耳朵罚抄几遍门规，关几天禁闭，说不定明烛真人心里还暗喜小徒弟终于开窍了呢！
天命之子嘛，肯定自带魅惑光环！
可轮到自己...呵呵。
在金丹真人眼里，他算哪根葱？估计刚摸到浴室的窗沿，就被随手一道真元，轰得连渣都不剩！
“对了，南师弟...”
龙涛深吸一口气，努力让声音听起来平稳自然，带着点恰到好处的局促和向往，“我有个不情之请，不知当讲不当讲？”
“师兄请说，只要不是违背道德良知的事，我一定尽力。”
“唉...其实我仰慕你师尊...明烛真人许久，只是身份低微，一直没机会瞻仰，而且听说你们漱月峰景色如同仙境，也想找机会去看看，不知有没有什么办法，能让我进入峰内参观一下，也算满足这么多年的夙愿。”
出乎龙涛意料，南宇辰听完非但没有为难的样子，反而噗嗤一声笑了出来，脸上带着点“果然如此”
的小得意。
“嘿嘿，我就知道！
师尊的仰慕者遍及宗门，没想到龙师兄也是！
能不能见到师尊我不敢打包票，但让你进峰内参观嘛...小事一桩！
这几日我们漱月峰的灵泉苑正在翻新扩建，我私下给你弄个帮工名额，光明正大进去！”
看看...这特么就是有关系的好处，漱月峰的任务报酬通常都很高，所以一般都是被那帮子内门弟子包场的，外门杂役连闻味儿的资格都没有，而现在...就因为认识了南宇辰这位亲传弟子，什么手续都不用，直接一句话就搞定。
不过南宇辰也是个大忙人，午时还没过...他就因为下午的修炼课程要立即离开，刚好龙涛这会儿也没心情聊天，两人便很干脆的互相道别，并且他让龙涛后天上午直接去漱月峰山门，报自己名字就好。
待天才少年走后，龙涛也重重叹了口气，任务场地的门票算是拿到了，剩下的...就看自己的造化了。
..........
拖着沉重双腿回到小院，龙涛只觉身心俱疲。
刚踏入院门，便瞧见蜘蛛妹妹罗雨丝，上半身的少女形态系着一条素色围裙，正认认真真地打扫着院中落叶。

这画面着实奇异，少女的身体，朴素的围裙，配上那非人的六只复眼和六条节肢长腿，竟透出一种难以名状的...异族侍女的古怪和谐感？甚至隐隐有几分异样美感？
这念头刚冒出来，龙涛就忍不住抬手给了自己脑门一下，他甚至怀疑是不是因为脑子里的那个狗系统，才让自己的审美出问题了。
“啊...龙涛道友，你回来了？”
罗雨丝被他的动作惊动，六只眼睛齐刷刷望过来，细声细气地问道。

content_en:
Long Tao looked at the content on the task panel and couldn't recover for a while. He blinked hard and confirmed it three times. The cold text was still clear and dazzling. The system asked him to sign in outside Master Mingzhu's bathroom, and also took Nan Yuchen to spy on his master's bath.
A cold numbness instantly overwhelmed all emotions.
He even lost the strength to curse and just sat there blankly, with only one absurd and cold thought lingering in his mind...
Either way, he was going to die. Would it be easier to be crushed into ashes by Master Mingzhu’s finger? Or should I be silently and completely wiped out by this dog system? Try to choose a less painful way to die.
"Senior Brother Long? What's wrong? He suddenly stopped talking."
Nan Yuchen looked at Long Tao who suddenly fell into silence, even his eyes were a little dull, and finally couldn't help shouting.
"Ah...nothing,"
Long Tao almost exhausted all his strength before he managed to put on a smile that was uglier than crying, "It's just...listening to you talking about this, I suddenly remembered the past when I was bullied by the old handymen when I first started working. Alas...it's not easy, it's not easy..."
Long Tao almost used all his acting skills to make himself look normal, otherwise he would really be unable to control himself and collapse and explode in this restaurant. With this stupid system, the previous mission was still a narrow escape, but this time... let him do whatever he wants!
That is Jin Dan Zhenren!
The Lord of the Peak!
Shuyue Peak is her absolute domain!
He is a little shrimp practicing qi. I am afraid that as soon as he steps into the peak realm, he will be locked by the ubiquitous terrifying consciousness. It would be easier to crush him to death than to crush an ant!
Compared with Master Mingzhu, the majestic Foundation-Building Wolf King before was just a bigger pet dog!
But Nan Yuchen didn't notice the turmoil in Long Tao's heart, and just complained about his grievances.
Looking at the silly boy in front of him, a small flame ignited in Long Tao's originally desperate heart. By the way...this boy is the most beloved disciple of Master Mingzhu, so...you might be able to find an almost impossible breakthrough point from him, such as...a ticket to enter the mission location.
Just like the dilemma I encountered last time, as an outer sect disciple at the fifth level of Qi training, it is impossible for me to enter Shuyue Peak under normal circumstances. Unlike the sect's public area like Wufengya, Shuyue Peak is the private domain of Master Mingzhu, and there is no way to enter through normal means.
Oh shit!
He finally understood it!
The task issued by this dog system is a cool script tailor-made for Nan Yuchen!
If he was asked to spy on a beautiful master taking a bath, he would probably be forced to have his ears pulled and read the rules several times, and be imprisoned for a few days. Maybe Master Mingzhu was secretly happy that his little apprentice had finally enlightened him!
The son of destiny must have a charming aura!
But it's my turn...hehe.
In the eyes of Master Jin Dan, who is he? It is estimated that as soon as he touched the bathroom window sill, he was hit by a burst of real energy, and not even the scum was left!
"By the way, Junior Brother Nan..."
Long Tao took a deep breath and tried to make his voice sound smooth and natural, with just the right amount of embarrassment and yearning, "I have an unkind request, should I tell it or not?"
"Senior brother, please tell me, as long as it is not against my moral conscience, I will do my best."
"Sigh... In fact, I have admired your master... Master Mingzhu for a long time. However, due to his low status, I have never had the opportunity to pay my respects. Moreover, I heard that the scenery of Shuyue Peak is like a fairyland, and I would like to find a chance to see it. I wonder if there is any way that I can enter the peak to visit, which can satisfy my long-cherished wish for so many years."
To Long Tao's expectation, Nan Yuchen not only didn't look embarrassed after hearing this, but actually laughed out loud, with a bit of "Sure enough" on his face.
Little pride.
"Hey, I knew it!
divisionI have admirers all over the sect, but I didn’t expect Senior Brother Long to be the same!
I can't guarantee whether you will be able to see Master, but let you visit the peak... It's a trivial matter!
Our Lingquan Garden in Shuyue Peak is being renovated and expanded these days. I will privately secure a helper spot for you. Come in openly and openly! "
Look...this is the benefit of having connections. The rewards for tasks at Shuyue Peak are usually very high, so they are usually booked by the inner disciples. The outer servants are not even qualified to smell. But now...just because I have met Nan Yuchen, a direct disciple, no formalities are required, and it can be done with just one sentence.
However, Nan Yuchen was also a busy man, and it was not yet past noon... He had to leave immediately because of the afternoon training class. It happened that Long Tao was not in the mood to chat at the moment, so the two of them said goodbye to each other simply, and he asked Long Tao to go directly to Shuyue Peak Mountain Gate the day after tomorrow morning and give his name.
After the genius boy left, Long Tao also sighed heavily. He finally got the ticket to the mission venue. The rest... depends on his luck.
...........
Dragging his heavy legs back to the small courtyard, Long Tao felt exhausted both physically and mentally.
As soon as she stepped into the courtyard, she saw Luo Yusi, the spider sister. Her upper body was in the form of a girl wearing a plain apron, and she was conscientiously cleaning the fallen leaves in the courtyard.
This scene is really strange. The girl's body, simple apron, coupled with the six inhuman compound eyes and six long jointed legs, actually reveal an indescribable... strange sense of harmony like an alien maid? It even has a slightly strange beauty?
As soon as this thought came to his mind, Long Tao couldn't help but raise his hand and give himself a slap on the forehead. He even wondered if it was because of the dog system in his mind that he had problems with his aesthetics.
"Ah... Fellow Taoist Long Tao, are you back? "
Luo Yusi was startled by his movements, all six eyes looked over, and she asked softly.
